correctness.rationale: Balanced-flow parametrization, five exhaustive connected positive-support cases, Euler circuit converse, and exact rational geometric-series summation establish the claim for every n>=3. Pole order gives n^4/288. Checked 78 symbolic coefficients, 20 connected-flow enumerations, 14 direct binary word censuses and 19 independent C++ direct enumerations; limits stated.

evidence: Jacquet–Knessl–Szpankowski present balanced matrix constant-term generating functions and asymptotics for unrestricted first-order Markov types and mention extension to higher order (PDF pp. 389–392).
Karhumäki–Puzynina–Rao–Whiteland derive a BEST-theorem formula for sizes of individual ordinary k-abelian classes, not a count of all cyclic observation vectors (arXiv pp. 2–7,11–14).
broader_coverage.reasoning: The first paper offers a general counting framework but no evaluated exact finite-length formula for binary cyclic trigram profiles. Applying the 4x4 complete-graph count by changing alphabet size does not enforce de Bruijn-compatible edges. Counting balanced solutions alone also includes disconnected support that cannot be one cyclic word.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: There is a method-level reduction to general Eulerian-flow counting, which is credited. An undiscovered all-graph explicit theorem could cover it, and remains a residual risk.
